edges.reason: Constructor stores the hardcoded shadowed _owner that launch() later passes to transferOwnership.
Constructor sets the liquidity wallet to owner().
transfer() forwards _msgSender() as the from address.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender for allowance deduction.
approve() uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
withdrawStuckETH sends the whole ETH balance to msg.sender.
onlyOwner compares the stored owner with _msgSender().
onlyOwner reads owner() for the access check.
launch() assigns the Uniswap V2 router.
launch() creates and stores the Uniswap pair.
launch() excludes router and pair from max transaction limits.
launch() hands contract ownership to the hardcoded address at the end.
The hardcoded shadowed _owner becomes the argument of transferOwnership.
newOwner parameter is written to storage by transferOwnership.
enableTrading() sets the early-buy penalty deadline.
_transfer branches on AMM pair status for limits and fees.
_transfer enforces maxTransactionAmount on buys and sells.
_transfer requires tx.gasprice to stay below gasPriceLimit.
Transfer-delay throttle is keyed on tx.origin, a phishing/relay vector.
Sniper penalty check compares earlyBuyPenaltyEnd with block.timestamp.
_transfer relies on restoreAllFee semantics for excluded accounts.
_transfer calls balanceOf for wallet and contract balance checks.
_transfer triggers swapBack when swap conditions are met.
amount parameter drives limit checks and fee computation.
from parameter determines fee mode and exclusions.
to parameter determines fee mode and exclusions.
Falls through to _transferStandard for non-excluded accounts.
_transferToExcluded writes t-space balance of the recipient.
_transferFromExcluded writes t-space balance of the sender.
_takeLiquidity reads buyOrSellSwitch to pick the fee split.
_takeLiquidity optionally credits the contract t-space balance.
Fee split uses raw multiplication and division by _liquidityFee.
tLiquidity parameter feeds the fee-split arithmetic.
Buy fee parameters are used as multipliers/dividers in the split.
Sell fee parameters are used as multipliers/dividers in the split.
Tax computation performs unchecked mul/div arithmetic.
_taxFee is the multiplier in the tax arithmetic.
restoreAllFee reads the cached fee values.
lockTheSwap toggles inSwapAndLiquify as a reentrancy guard around swapBack.
swapBack reads and resets accumulated liquidity tokens.
swapBack reads and resets accumulated marketing tokens.
swapBack converts contract tokens into ETH.
swapBack adds the liquidity portion back to the pair.
swapBack sends marketing ETH through an unchecked low-level call.
swapBack sends dev ETH through an unchecked low-level call.
swapBack sweeps leftover ETH to marketing with an unchecked call.
marketingAddress is the destination of the unchecked ETH send.
devAddress is the destination of the unchecked ETH send.
market ingAddress receives the leftover ETH sweep.
contractBalance local variable drives the swap amount.
ethForMarketing local variable is sent to the marketing wallet.
ethForDev local variable is sent to the dev wallet.
success flag returned by the unchecked marketing call is ignored.
swapTokensForETH calls the router swap function.
Router stored in uniswapV2Router receives the external call.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline.
addLiquidity calls the router addLiquidityETH function.
Router stored in uniswapV2Router receives the liquidity call.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidity deadline.
excludeFromReward reads the reflection balance of the account.
account parameter selects the reward-exclusion target.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to the internal helper.
Helper also updates max-transaction exclusions for the pair.
Helper excludes the pair from rewards when value is true.
Helper includes the pair in rewards when value is false.
balanceOf reads the account reflection balance.
balanceOf reads the account t-space balance for excluded accounts.
balanceOf converts reflection balances into token amounts.
tokenFromReflection divides by the current rate.
transferForeignToken performs an external ERC20 transfer.
_token parameter is dereferenced as an arbitrary ERC20 contract.
_to parameter is the recipient of the rescued tokens.
withdrawStuckETH drains the balance via an unchecked low-level call.
The drained ETH is sent to msg.sender.
withdrawStuckETH only runs while trading is inactive.
setBuyFee writes the buy fee parameters.
setSellFee writes the sell fee parameters.
setMarketingAddress toggles fee exclusion for the wallet.
removeBoughtEarly clears the sniper flag of an account.
receive() accepts ETH sent back by the Uniswap router.
